title: Normalisation statistics
description: SEAM 1. data/splits/norm_stats.json - per-channel mean and standard deviation used to normalise every image, for every model, in every run. Produced by Member 1; applied inside build_dataloaders so no other member ever normalises anything themselves. Committed to git.

mean.description: Per-channel mean over pixel values scaled to [0, 1].

std.description: Per-channel standard deviation. Must be strictly positive or normalisation divides by zero.

fitted_on.description: Locked to 'train'. Fitting normalisation on val or test leaks held-out information into training, which would make the reported test accuracy dishonest. The schema refuses any other value on purpose.

num_images.description: How many training images the statistics were computed over.

pretrained_override.description: Optional. ImageNet statistics, if Member 4 chooses to normalise the pretrained backbones the way their weights were trained. Using this is a documented deviation and must be mentioned in Section 5.
